caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with an open lid, shown in a three-quarters perspective. The exterior of the chest is brown with visible wood grain texture and features vertical, dark brown metal bands and a lock plate at the front. The chest's interior appears a muted tan or yellowish-brown, and the underside of the lid is painted blue. On the blue interior lid, decorative flourishes, the year "1831," and the name "Jacob Pentz" are written in dark script. The side of the lid has a zig-zag pattern in a darker brown color. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or scenery, and the artist's signature, "Eugene C. Mullen," is faintly visible below the chest along with the year "1936."
title: Wooden Chest
